annotations.title: EVE Frontier Tribe Diplomatic Standings & Access Matrix Auditor

description: Audits EVE Frontier Tribe diplomatic standings, friendly/hostile reputation scores, and pilot override entries across solar systems. Use when checking diplomatic relations or detecting conflicting friendly-fire rules across tribe registries; for compiling those standings into executable Sui Move Smart Gate ACL bytecode, use compile_eve_gate_acl instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'tribe_id' ('standing_filter' defaults to 'all'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

standing_filter.description: Filter returned diplomatic relationships by tier; defaults to 'all' when omitted.

tribe_id.description: Primary Tribe identifier or registry object ID to audit (e.g. 'tribe-corinth-01').

name: audit_eve_tribe_standings

acl_conflicts_detected.description: True if a pilot override contradicts their parent tribe standing.

allied_tribes_count.description: Count of tribes holding positive diplomatic standing.

hostile_tribes_count.description: Count of tribes flagged as hostile targets.
